source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Snooze and dismiss return early only when modifyItem resolves with the requested saved property or acknowledgement. A rejected write now logs a warning and reaches the same local ignore path as a resolved write that did not preserve the requested state. This handles the awaited write failure, not every possible exception in the method. The original ignored the item without a cutoff; fixed accepted dismiss later stores an acknowledgement time to preserve future occurrences. Keep that later recurrence behavior separate from this error-catching phase.
title: Alarm write rejection shares the local fallback for an ineffective saved result
